title: Dedication of the Temple

questions.question: What did Solomon say the LORD has chosen to dwell in?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:1 (ESV): "The LORD has said that he would dwell in thick darkness."

questions.question: Who did Solomon bless before praying?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:3 (ESV): "Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel..."

questions.question: What did God say to David regarding building the house?
options: You shall not build the house... your son shall build it
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not build the house... your son shall build it
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:8-9 (ESV): "...Nevertheless, you shall not build the house, but your son who shall be born to you shall build the house..."

questions.question: Where did Solomon stand to pray?
options: Before the altar of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Before the altar of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:12 (ESV): "Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the assembly of Israel..."

questions.question: What platform did Solomon stand on?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:13 (ESV): "Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high..."

questions.question: What posture did Solomon take during the prayer?
options: Knelt on his knees and spread out his hands toward heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Knelt on his knees and spread out his hands toward heaven
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:13 (ESV): "...he knelt on his knees in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven."

questions.question: What did Solomon acknowledge about God's containment?
options: Heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain You
questions.correctAnswer: Heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain You
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:18 (ESV): "But will God indeed dwell with man on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you, how much less this house that I have built!"

questions.question: Toward what should the people pray?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:21 (ESV): "...when they pray toward this place..."

questions.question: What happens if a man sins against his neighbor and is made to take an oath?
options: Hear from heaven and act and judge your servants
questions.correctAnswer: Hear from heaven and act and judge your servants
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:22-23 (ESV): "...then hear from heaven and act and judge your servants..."

questions.question: If the people sin and are defeated by an enemy, what should they do?
options: Turn again to You and acknowledge Your name and pray
questions.correctAnswer: Turn again to You and acknowledge Your name and pray
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:24 (ESV): "...if they turn again to you and acknowledge your name and pray..."

questions.question: Why should God answer the prayers for rain?
options: That they may learn to fear You and walk in Your ways
questions.correctAnswer: That they may learn to fear You and walk in Your ways
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:31 (ESV): "that they may fear you and walk in your ways..."

questions.question: What did Solomon ask regarding the foreigner?
options: Do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You
questions.correctAnswer: Do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:33 (ESV): "...do according to all for which the foreigner calls to you..."

questions.question: What phrase describes the sinfulness of humanity in Solomon’s prayer?
options: For there is no one who does not sin
questions.correctAnswer: For there is no one who does not sin
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:36 (ESV): "...for there is no one who does not sin..."

questions.question: How should they allow their heart to return to God in captivity?
options: With all their heart and with all their soul
questions.correctAnswer: With all their heart and with all their soul
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:38 (ESV): "if they repent with all their heart and with all their soul..."

questions.question: What concludes Solomon's prayer?
options: Let your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in your goodness
questions.correctAnswer: Let your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in your goodness
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 6:41 (ESV): "...Let your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in your goodness."

key_verse_text: But will God indeed dwell with man on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you, how much less this house that I have built!
